changes.oldText: After logging in, you can check the information of the current resource usage on the Start page.

changes.oldText: The sidebar lists only the pages you are allowed to open. Every user sees the general menu groups; the Administration groups appear in addition for superadmins and domain admins.
changes.newText: The sidebar lists only the pages you are allowed to open. Superadmins and domain admins open the administration pages from the user menu with Switch to Admin Console; when you are a project admin of the selected project, the sidebar also shows a Project Settings entry.
